Name: FS - Cozy Mittens
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/lmWLi29.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Cozy Mittens is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] pack which adds multiple recolorable mitten accessories via the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url] tool. Additionally, this pack comes with a sweater shirt and a pair of thicker sleeves.
[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/GyuRdl9.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://imgur.com/fP5yPeU.png[/img]
[b][size=3]How do I wear one of the mittens?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "accessories" button.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Where is the beanie from?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10659]SmolHooman's More Accessories pack[/url].[/size]
[/list]
